profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Web Developer | C# | ASP.NET | Angular | React | MS SQL
profile.summary:
An analytical and articulate full-stack web developer with a meticulous approach to problem solving, planning and implementing technical solutions. Able to grasp new concepts quickly and well versed in C#, .NET, ASP.NET, SQL and jQuery. Experienced in varied technical frameworks including mapping APIs and data indexing and analysis. Exposure to several project management methodologies and tools.

Interested in furthering my career in a challenging technical application development environment. Passionate about resolving defects in complex systems.

Experienced in:
• Full-stack web development (database, services, user interfaces, etc)
• Supporting multiple systems (legacy included)
• Managing user requirements and acceptance
• Estimating, designing, developing and maintaining complex systems
• Identifying bugs and devising solutions and workarounds
• Production and technical support
• Quickly learning new tools and technologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I am a software engineer developing the forms, dashboards and tools used to sign up both individuals and companies, and perform a variety of regulatory checks on the applicants and their associates.

•	Designed, architected and implemented the core application forms, including the front-end, bank-end and database (ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, SQL Server).
•	Split, combined and streamlined forms based on feedback from users, the product owner and session recordings.
•	Learned ReactJS and implemented the existing forms in ReactJS (using Redux Form). Allowing for improved maintainability and quicker turn around on new forms and changes to existing forms.
•	Integrated with multiple external APIs including the implementation of a recursive ownership percentage algorithm using shareholder information.
•	Architected and implemented complex business logic, specifying user stories and acceptance criteria based on product owner requirements. This includes a verification process that could be performed as a stand-alone action or as a prerequisite to some other applicant tasks.
•	Assisted junior developers with their development including paired programming and code review.
•	Maintained and augmented the code base of the system by adding helpful methods/extensions/ overrides and reengineering solutions (enforcing principles such as separation of concerns).
•	Figured out and resolved complicated production issues.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.locationName: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa · On-site
positions.description:
I was in the platform development team ensuring web applications were soundly engineered and deployed in line with industry best practice.

•Took ownership of an ASP.NET Web Forms system (SQL, LINQ, jQuery, jQuery UI, ExtJS) that, having been neglected for some time, required numerous bug fixes and regression testing
•Assisting in migrating a web system to AWS hosting and automated deployments using Nuget, Powershell, Jenkins and Octopus
•Addressed performance issues by refactoring C# and SQL code
•Wrote unit tests using NUnit and Moq. Managed continuous integration using Jenkins
•Improved the searchability of data by implementing an indexing and retrieval service using Apache Solr and Lucene, later updated to Elasticsearch
•Updated a web system to require an HTTP Client Certificate for support users to login
•Added a customised Google Chart allowing customers to monitor frontline worker activity
•Implemented a mechanism to import data using a programmatically generated Excel template (Flexcel)
•Updated a web system to use the latest Google Maps and Bing Maps APIs
•Implemented a data export service that writes data to a third-party text format in an efficient manner •Added customisations to an ExtJS grid that allowed persistent fixed columns and generic server-side ordering of data
•Worked with a mobile developer to implement features that required communicate between a mobile application and a web system. Such as allowing a mobile device to be configured based on a QR code
•Implemented an ASP.NET MVC 3 system used to administer other web systems (Razor, SQL, LLBLGen, Dapper, Sass, jQuery, ExtJS)
•Implemented an ASP.NET Web API 2 system used to top-up SIM cards. The system integrated with two third party APIs (SQL, EF 6)
•With the CTO and platform development team, took an Agile approach to the development of the systems
•Liaised with internal stakeholders
•Assisted front-line support staff with providing customers with prompt solutions to their technical issues

educations.schoolName: Glenwood High School, Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa
